shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- agent files ---'; find .. -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- home ---'; sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- product ---'; sed -n '1,260p' app/product/page.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- layout ---'; sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- data ---'; sed -n '1,260p' lib/data.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- config ---'; cat next.config.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- relevant docs ---'; rg -l \"loading\\.tsx|Streaming|Suspense|prefetch\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- loading convention ---'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- instant navigation ---'; sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- cache components migration excerpts ---'; rg -n -C 5 \"Suspense|connection\\(\\)|static shell|dynamic\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | sed -n '1,260p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- fetching excerpts ---'; rg -n -C 5 \"Suspense|stream\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md | sed -n '1,220p'"
